correctness.rationale: Cut expansion is exact for every four-site real vector, and strict positivity settles all extremizers. Even/odd spectral blocks give both branches; exact resolvent factorization gives Δ=2[(r−1)g+r(q*g)]. Strict log-concavity of g proves monotonicity of (q*g)/g, exactly one transition for r<1, and no transition for r≥1. Scaling asymptotics are proved. Matrix exponential verification independently checked 200 settings and 4000 vectors.

value.rationale: The cut location is a natural diagnostic for approximation error under nonuniform thermal conductance. The theorem is a complete two-parameter/time sharp classification on the smallest symmetric bottleneck path with moving worst cuts, including exact asymptotic migration time near equilibrium and under a severe bottleneck. The result distinguishes local fast-edge and global cardinality effects.
